mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 1% indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during FEDFUNDS < 1% periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200k/month, a tightening labor market signals positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window for this interaction-driven signal.

mechanism_narrative: An INDPRO reading above 105 signals increased industrial production, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during non-recessionary regimes.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of non-recessionary periods with INDPRO > 105.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in HOUST exceeding 10% YoY signals a housing market boom, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 2.5-year rolling window for this signal.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both increase over a 3-month period, a monetary tightening cycle with rising inflation signals negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both increase over 3mo
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of periods with concurrent FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL increases.

mechanism_narrative: An UNRATE reading above 5% signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but only during economic downturns.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.01 over any 6-month rolling window for this regime-conditional signal.

mechanism_narrative: A RSAFS reading above $500B signals increased retail sales, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, with no specific regime conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns with RSAFS > $500B are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
